answer: The voyage schedule is applied in mirror and zephyr makes public each instalment. A payout is split which means 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1909 identities would post 624 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
